scope.immutability: This file permanently declares source-required coverage. Characterization, observations, metrics, floors, and current dispositions live outside this contract and may never remove a requirement.
scope.acceptance_rule: Each requirement must be resolved in characterization/completion evidence as PASS or explicitly approved APPROVED_UNSUPPORTED_GEOMETRY. FAIL or BLOCKED there prevents completion without mutating this declaration.

cross_cutting_requirements.capability: A fixed request set with fixed per-request seeds must execute exact token-ID comparisons with batched prefill at admission cardinalities 1, 2, 4, and 32, using 32 true active-batch-1 sequential-prefill controls, and record either INVARIANT or BATCHED_PREFILL_REJECTED.
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance_condition: For every listed geometry and both profiles, either disposition satisfies experiment completion only when every control and candidate output is complete. BATCHED_PREFILL_REJECTED is a completed negative disposition and does not pass invariance; malformed or incomplete execution, skips, xfails, or missing rows fail.

cross_cutting_requirements.capability: The executor must explicitly disable batched prefill whenever device sampling is enabled; BH determinism-sensitive execution follows the recorded INVARIANT or BATCHED_PREFILL_REJECTED verdict and retains sequential prefill unless batch invariance is proven.
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance_condition: Production remains sequential after BATCHED_PREFILL_REJECTED on any required geometry; policy may be reconsidered only after INVARIANT evidence for every required geometry and profile. This retained-policy requirement is independent of completed experiment disposition.

cross_cutting_requirements.capability: Explicit FABRIC_1D_RING and model Ring CCL topology must pass the Phase-0 probe and remain pinned per demo and serving row.
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance_condition: Immutable qualification evidence demonstrates this capability for every listed geometry without dropping a profile, workload, or row.

cross_cutting_requirements.capability: Every required P150, P150x4, and P300 trace mode must use the central trace-region resolver; actual TTTv2 capture sizes are measured per real SKU and models/model_trace_region_sizes.yaml is updated where they differ from inherited values. Dynamic allocation is a provisional development fallback, not a substitute for the required measurement record.
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance_condition: Immutable qualification evidence demonstrates this capability for every listed geometry without dropping a profile, workload, or row.

cross_cutting_requirements.capability: A missing or incomplete metric floor must not block BH model execution or observational measurement, but the resulting measurements cannot establish performance acceptance. Every complete declared floor remains enforced, every failed meets_target result fails, and performance acceptance requires an independently justified, frozen floor.
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance_condition: Immutable qualification evidence may record observational measurements when a floor is missing or incomplete, but records performance acceptance only when a complete independently frozen floor exists and every declared target passes.

cross_cutting_requirements.capability: Every required demo case must pass cold-write and warm-read cache runs without implicit fallback; each serving row pins and validates its cache root.
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance_condition: Immutable qualification evidence demonstrates this capability for every listed geometry without dropping a profile, workload, or row.

cross_cutting_requirements.capability: Every required node must have an exact pytest --collect-only ID, nonzero passes, and zero unexpected skips/xfails.
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance_condition: Immutable qualification evidence demonstrates this capability for every listed geometry without dropping a profile, workload, or row.
